shots.focal_element: Plush Oscar character with a moustache, seated in a director's chair in front of a pink stage curtain
shots.what_happens: Starts as a centred medium close-up of Oscar answering the interview (w83-w92, 'Oh, you know me. I've got some big, big plans.'). The camera then pulls back and pans, revealing a microphone held in from the left and a second Oscar entering the frame on the left. Meanwhile the subject's moustache swells to a comically oversized size.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a centred plush-character close-up on a pink curtain backdrop, then animate a camera pull-out with a slight pan right over about 1 s while scaling the moustache mesh up about 1.5x, so the interviewer and mic enter frame left.

shots.focal_element: Two Oscars in director's chairs: interviewer with a mic on the left, interviewee with a giant moustache on the right
shots.typography: Easel poster title: bold rounded sans-serif in all caps, white on green, with a smaller 'THE' above a larger 'MASTER'. The font looks like Duolingo's brand face (low-confidence guess: Feather Bold).
shots.what_happens: A wide talk-show two-shot holds on the stage. On the left an easel poster reads 'THE MASTER' and shows Oscar at a chessboard. The interviewee winks smugly behind the oversized moustache as the line 'big plans' ends (w91-w92).
shots.build_rebuild: Stage two character rigs in director's chairs a third of the frame apart on a curtain set, add a background easel poster with a bold all-caps title, and hold a static wide shot for about 1 s while the right character plays a one-eye wink.

shots.focal_element: Oscar spinning in place in front of a diagonal pink/teal painted brick wall, with a boombox on the ground and a yellow bollard
shots.transition_other: Hard cut to a new street-wall location; the shot detector labelled it 'other'.
shots.what_happens: A music-video style insert: Oscar dances and spins with heavy motion blur next to a boombox. He turns back to camera holding up a phone just as the VO starts 'Cintillating new' (w93-w94). Several impact/swoosh SFX land across the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a static wide shot of a two-tone diagonal brick wall, then spin the character 360 degrees twice with motion blur over about 1.5 s and end facing camera with a phone raised in one hand, timing the spin stops to the SFX hits.

shots.focal_element: Phone held at right third showing a Duolingo Chess lesson screen with an animated skeleton character, beside Oscar's face
shots.transition_other: Hard cut punch-in from the wide wall shot to a close-up; the shot detector labelled it 'other'.
shots.typography: In-app UI type: a small bold sans-serif 'That's correct' feedback label, and an all-caps bold label on a green 'CONTINUE' button. A tiny header at the top of the phone screen is unreadable.
shots.what_happens: A close-up shows Oscar presenting the phone, whose app screen has a zapped skeleton character and a 'That's correct' success state. The scene then goes dark and a blue lightning bolt strikes the phone from above, glowing against the dimmed frame.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a phone mockup with an app success screen at the right third of a character close-up, then cut the exposure to about 20% for about 0.3 s and overlay an animated blue lightning-bolt sprite with an additive glow hitting the phone.

shots.focal_element: Electrocuted Oscar with frizzed hair, a smouldering moustache with flames and smoke, holding up the phone
shots.transition_other: Return to full exposure after the lightning flash: a flash-cut aftermath; the shot detector labelled it 'other'.
shots.what_happens: This is the comic payoff of the lightning strike. Oscar stands scorched, with wild frizzy hair, flames licking his moustache and smoke rising, while the phone in his hand cycles through app animations: a character celebrating, then a screen showing course flags. 'animations.' (w95) lands here. The shot ends in a fast motion-blurred move toward the phone, which leads into the full-screen UI. The phone screen text is too small to read.
shots.build_rebuild: Swap the character to a scorched variant (frizz hair groom, soot texture), add looping flame and smoke particle sims on the moustache, play an app animation on the in-hand phone screen, and finish with a 0.2 s motion-blurred camera push toward the phone.

shots.focal_element: Full-frame recreated app card with a course selector (Chess highlighted, French, German) above an ELO PROGRESS line chart
shots.transition_other: Motion-blurred push from the in-hand phone into a full-frame flat UI card; the exact mechanics are not visible at 2 fps.
shots.typography: Duolingo-style rounded bold sans-serif: dark-grey title-case course labels under icon tiles, a small all-caps grey section label 'ELO PROGRESS' with slight letter-spacing, and light grey tabular axis numerals. Low-confidence guess for the font: Feather Bold / DIN Round.
shots.what_happens: A flat white UI card is shown on a solid teal field. The Chess course tile is selected with a blue outline next to French and German flag tiles. Below them a green ELO line chart climbs from about 1125 to 1200 as the VO says 'Track your elo progress.' (w96-w99). The card then exits with a strong horizontal motion blur.
shots.build_rebuild: Build a white centred card on a solid brand-teal background with three icon tiles (the first outlined as selected), an all-caps 'ELO PROGRESS' label and a 9-point green polyline chart over 4 gridlines, then exit it with a 0.2 s horizontal slide plus directional blur.
